content: Thousands of candles can be lighted from a single candle, and the life of the candle will not be shortened. Happiness never decreases by being shared.
author: Gautama Buddha
explanation:
In this illuminating teaching from Sutra of Forty-Two Sections, Gautama Buddha directs our attention away from the restless turbulence of external seeking to the unshakeable foundation within. When we get caught in mental chatter, social anxiety, and habitual reactivity, we forget the underlying silence that sustains our awareness. By contemplating happiness, we dissolve the illusion of separateness and discover a profound clarity that transforms everyday life.

True wisdom is not something to be acquired like a new possession; it is the natural fragrance of a mind that has learned to be still. When you align your daily conduct with this understanding, you move through the world with unshakeable grace, freedom, and deep peace.
practicalInsight: Practice conscious happiness today. Whenever you feel pulled into mental restlessness, pause and anchor yourself in quiet presence.
reflectionPrompt: How can greater awareness of happiness dissolve the primary stress or doubt in your mind today?
